data.body:
RCA/design escalation (2026-08-17), before implementation. The inert manual result is confirmed: review_code() checks code_review_enabled(repo_root) before building a request, so explicit CLI/library/MCP intent is discarded when verify.enable_code_review is false. Caller inventory found exactly two production paths: the public shim and review_bot/adapter.py. The adapter intentionally sends enabled=True because deployed receiver activation is already the enforcement decision; rebar.toml currently sets no enable_code_review key, yet Gerrit LLM-Review is live. Therefore renaming the flag to enforce_code_review and removing the adapter override would disable the live Gerrit gate unless an operational config/deployment migration lands atomically.

Decision required. Recommended compatible contract: explicit public review-code always runs (the shim sends enabled=True); preserve verify.enable_code_review as the opt-in default only for direct/internal produce_code_review_verdict calls; keep the review-bot explicit override because receiver deployment is its enforcement control; update docs to stop describing explicit review-code as disabled. Alternative: create a true enforce_code_review key, wire the voter to it, and coordinate repo/deployment config so Gerrit remains enforced; this is a broader operational semantic change. No production edit or reproduction gate has started pending operator choice.
